description: This file declares the exported API functions for the TLS Module Container Object, including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions. It is part of the TLS implementation for the BroadWay Service Delivery System.

methods.name: TlsCreateModuleContainer
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle for the TLS Module Container object, initializing it with container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: TlsMcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the TLS Module Container object with specified contexts.

methods.name: TlsMcoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified TLS Module Container object.

methods.name: TlsMcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls required objects into the TLS Module Container object.

methods.name: TlsMcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the TLS Module Container object after creation and enrollment.
